resources.string: Keeps the Arena AI page loaded in memory so it does not have to reload when you come back to the app.
Your session stays loaded in the background. Tap to open.

Arena AI keeps your session loaded using a background service, and Android requires that service to show an ongoing notification. Without notification permission the service still runs, but you will not see the notification and will not have its quick “Stop” button — you can always stop the session from the menu inside the app.\n\nYou can grant the permission later in Settings → Apps → Arena AI → Notifications.

Android and most phone makers (Samsung, Xiaomi, OPPO, Huawei and others) aggressively put background apps to sleep to save battery. If that happens to Arena AI, your page is unloaded and has to reload the next time you open the app.\n\nTo prevent that, exclude Arena AI from battery optimization. On the next screen, find Arena AI and set it to Don\'t optimize / Unrestricted.

Arena AI is already excluded from battery optimization — that is the setting we need.\n\nSome phone makers add a second, separate switch (often called “Sleeping apps”, “Auto-launch”, “App battery usage” or “Protected apps”). If your session still gets unloaded, look for that setting too.
Find “Arena AI” in the list and choose “Don\'t optimize”.
Open Settings → Apps → Arena AI → Battery and choose “Unrestricted”.
This unloads the page from memory and closes Arena AI. The next time you open the app the page will load again from the start.\n\nYou stay signed in.

Keeps the user\'s arena.ai web session loaded in memory so that returning to the app resumes the exact same page, with no reload and no loss of in-progress work. The service is started by an explicit user action and runs only until the user stops it from the notification or from inside the app.
